input.title: Grandchildren is gone when user Swap Note on the Children
input.body:
## Step to reproduce
1. Create Thought A
2. Create Subthought B as A's children
3. Create Subthoought C as B's children
4. Place the caret on B
5. Swipe ↑←→ to Swap Note



## Current behavior
Subthought B become a Note to Thought A
Grandchildren C is gone.
It remains be a subthought of the b as a note but not visible
Grandchildren is visible when user Swap Note B as subthought again.

**Video:**

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c1c3aadd-16b2-48ea-8227-dfffcf1a54b0

## Expected behavior: 
The grandchildren should move to A as a subthought (children)
